preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(v, int) and v >= 0 and v < V for v in sum(adj, []))
preconditions.description: All vertices in the adjacency list are valid indices in the range [0, V-1].

preconditions.expression: all(len(neighbors) == len(set(neighbors)) for neighbors in adj)
preconditions.description: No duplicate edges exist in the adjacency list (undirected graph property).
The graph has at least one vertex.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 2 and all(deg % 2 == 0 for deg in [len(adj[v]) for v in range(V)])
postconditions.description: If the return value is 2, every vertex has even degree (Eulerian Circuit exists).

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 and sum(1 for deg in [len(adj[v]) for v in range(V)] if deg % 2 == 1) == 2
postconditions.description: If the return value is 1, exactly two vertices have odd degree (Eulerian Path exists).

postconditions.expression: return_value == 0 and (any(deg % 2 == 1 for deg in [len(adj[v]) for v in range(V)]) or sum(1 for deg in [len(adj[v]) for v in range(V)] if deg % 2 == 1) > 2)
postconditions.description: If the return value is 0, either more than two vertices have odd degree or the graph is disconnected (no Eulerian Path/Circuit exists).
The return value is either 0 (no Eulerian Path/Circuit), 1 (Eulerian Path exists), or 2 (Eulerian Circuit exists).
